players.product: Enterprise SATA SSDs, PCIe SSDs and RDIMM modules for AI servers and data centers; mSSD and embedded storage

quarterly_data.signal: Management (IR record): its mSSD (Micro SSD) integrates the controller chip, NAND dies and passive components in one SiP package measuring 20x30x2.0 mm, meets PCIe performance standards with a simplified production flow, and has reached scaled commercial use at several leading global PC makers.

Management (IR record): Qualcomm announced multi-party cooperation with Longsys and other partners to adapt and optimize the StepEdge-Omni 30B-MoE model for on-device inference on a sixth-generation Snapdragon 8 mobile platform; Longsys' on-device AI storage solution loads model weights efficiently from on-device NAND Flash, reducing sustained DRAM use.

Longsys.why: NAND-based storage maker (own controller chips) shipping enterprise SATA/PCIe SSDs and RDIMMs into AI servers and data centers; sells more as AI storage demand grows.
Longsys.evidence: Longsys investor Q&A: SZSE Interactive Easy (09-18-2026): enterprise storage products are widely used in AI servers and data centers; volume shipments of SATA SSD, PCIe SSD and RDIMM.
